app.title: Interval Trainer
app.tagline: Sing it. Hold it. Hear the chime.

single.name: Single note
single.desc: Find one pitch and hold it.

warmup.title: Warm-up sing-along
warmup.cardDesc: Sing along to the track — watch your pitch ride the line.

detector.title: Pitch detector
detector.cardDesc: Sing freely — the notes you hold light up and fade away.
detector.hint: Sing a melody. The notes you stay on longest stand out; older ones fade.

trainer.replayAnchor: Replay the song — the braced notes are your interval

listen.name: Listen
listen.hint: Hear it in a tune you know.

walk.name: Walk up
walk.hint: Sing the scale up to the note.

echo.name: Echo
echo.hint: Same root — sing the leap back.

transpose.name: Transpose
transpose.hint: New root each time — sing the leap.

cold.name: Cold
cold.hint: No reference — find it by ear.

one.name: The root
one.hint: Hold it until it's dead on.

three.name: The third
three.hint: Hold it until it's dead on.

oneThreeOne.name: Root & third
oneThreeOne.hint: Sing each note, hold to confirm.

five.name: The fifth
five.hint: Hold it until it's dead on.

oneThreeFive.name: The triad
oneThreeFive.hint: Sing each note, hold to confirm.

arpeggio.name: Full arpeggio
arpeggio.hint: Sing the whole arpeggio, hold each note.

arpeggioSolo.name: On your own
arpeggioSolo.hint: No confirming chime — land every note yourself to clear the key.

status.listenGuided: Listen to the target, then sing it.
status.listenEar: Here's your start note — sing it, then find the next by ear.
status.listenRung: Just listen — hear how the interval sits in the tune.
status.nailedIt: 🎉 Nailed it! Here's what you sang…

calibrate.title: Set your vocal range
calibrate.hintLow: Sing your LOWEST comfortable "ah" — not a growl, just easy and low.
calibrate.hintHigh: Now sing your HIGHEST comfortable "ah" — no straining.
calibrate.captureLow: Hold, then press to capture LOW
calibrate.captureHigh: Hold, then press to capture HIGH
calibrate.noSteady: Didn't catch a steady note — try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Tune the exercise and how it plays. Saved automatically.
settings.tutorialHint: Ladder walks each interval easy→hard; free practice drills randomly.
settings.modeHint: Guided plays every note; ear gives only the start.
settings.sweepHint: One octave at a time, or the whole range.
settings.guideToneHint: A quiet drone holds note 1 until you land it.
settings.foundChimeHint: Play the note the moment you land on it.
settings.holdHint: How long to hold a single note.
